name: Team Dhi
description:
Inaugurated in 2022, Team Dhi is the official student club of the AI & ML Department, RVCE.
Rooted in the Sanskrit word for intelligence and understanding, Dhi represents the bridge between human cognition and Artificial Intelligence.
We are a community dedicated to exploring, building, and solving real-world problems using cutting-edge AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science.

Our verticals include Nexus AIML, Business Intelligence and Core Operations.

events.name: Prompt Wars
events.detail: Teams compete to solve increasingly difficult challenges using only prompts under strict constraints like word limits, banned keywords, or zero follow-up attempts. Participants learn prompt engineering, context management, and the limitations of LLMs.

events.name: The Human Neural Network
events.detail: A zero-code game, where the audience are turned into a living, breathing AI brain! Freshers will be divided into Input, Hidden, and Output layers to pass, filter, and process secret data. They'll experience firsthand how a neural network learns from its mistakes, adapts, and makes decisions - all through a chaotic, fast-paced race against the clock. No coding required, just pure logic and teamwork!

events.name: Copilot
events.detail: A practical introduction showing freshers how artificial intelligence isn't a shortcut, but a mandatory power tool for learning, debugging, and solving complex problems in modern engineering.
